package minimal.pkg.abstracts.weaver;

import org.lara.interpreter.weaver.LaraWeaverEngine;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * Auto-generated abstract weaver class for MinimalWeaver.
 */
public abstract class AMinimalWeaver extends LaraWeaverEngine {

    public List<String> getJoinPointClassNames() {
        return List.of(
            "joinpoint",
            "root"
        );
    }

    @Override
    public String getRoot() {
        return "root";
    }

    public boolean implementsEvents() {
        return true;
    }
}
